items.title: How Amazon tracks carbon intensity across its operations
items.summary: At Amazon, we believe that as our strategy to reach net-zero by 2040 evolves, we need to continue to raise the bar on what and how we measure. Measuring carbon emissions across our entire business is complex, and the tools and methodologies available are continuously improving.
